businessGoal: Enable users to find products easily within specific categories.

scenarios.goal: Verify that clicking on a category name displays the corresponding product page and updates the page title.
Verify that when the category page is displayed, all required filters are available.

manual.reason: The story involves user interactions and UI components which need to be tested manually.

api.reason: The story does not specify any behavior that can be validated through an API.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria specify visible browser behavior and interactions that need testing.
